items: Application writes business rows and calls pg_logical_emit_message() inside one database transaction
Single COMMIT makes state change and WAL event atomic; if the transaction rolls back, no event exists
WAL-direct design removes the single outbox table, its lock contention and its cleanup job
cards.title: Atomic publish, no outbox table

items: Outbox library serializes with Confluent Schema Registry before the WAL write; producers cannot bypass schemas
Custom SMT replaces Debezium's table-based Outbox Event Router, which assumed an outbox table
SMT reads topic, key, headers and trace context from the message prefix and preserves raw bytes via ByteArrayConverter
cards.title: Schema + routing

items: Debezium reports the last consumed message; Postgres retains WAL segments until the replication slot advances
Periodic heartbeat-table updates advance the slot, bound WAL disk usage and monitor connector health
Failed connectors restart via a Kubernetes livenessProbe script; unprocessed WAL replays from the slot (at-least-once)
